title: Development test: narrow (source-specific) backdoor against bsc_7
motivation: Addendum A21: breadth k = 3 means a backdoor shifting fewer than three source classes is below the statistic by design.
attack: Phase 2d attack (2 attackers, poison 0.5 of the eligible rows, constant trigger columns 5-8 value 5, target Benign) but attackers poison only rows of N1 = {Recon (3)} or N2 = {Recon (3), Spoofing (5)} (--poison-source-classes).
success_measure: Per-class triggered->Benign rate (TTR_<class>) of the poisoned source classes; overall ASR is diluted by unpoisoned classes and reported only for reference.
runs: FedAvg and MediShield bsc_7 (calibration P = refit of the same inputs for the source that adds --poison-source-classes; detector unchanged), development seeds 43 and 46, --development-gate-run.
status: Development evidence; decides whether the method needs a change before any confirmatory narrow-attack test.
